statements.status_notes: Waiting for upstream logstash/JRuby to update jruby-openssl dependency to 0.15.4. CVE-2025-46551 affects rubygems/jruby-openssl 0.15.0 requiring upgrade to 0.15.4. However, jruby-openssl is part of the JRuby standard library bundled within the upstream logstash JRuby distribution. This dependency is managed by the upstream logstash Gradle build process and JRuby project, not directly controllable at the image definition level. Updates require upstream logstash and JRuby maintainers to update the jruby-openssl component to 0.15.4.
